subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 3 1 6 9 6 2 1 5 8 5 3 3 8 2 6 1 7 3 7 8 7 4 9 1 5 7 4 (Right)

How many such even digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 3 1 6 9 6 2 1 5 8 5 3 3 8 2 6 1 7 3 7 8 7 4 9 1 5 7 4 (Right)

Now,

Even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b2f82f5f0524b3cee4b4db39b41a8708a901344bd62f0ceadcc4e8e116cf862.png] 

Thus, there is one even digit, which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
